decisions.reason: The pegboard display serves hook-merchandise customers using existing cardboard capacity, but it was absent from the website in 2020–2021 and the 2022 energy and paper-cost squeeze is shrinking slack, so withdrawal is close to even odds.
The standard quarter-pallet display is a core, high-volume format that likely still meets aspirations despite rising input costs, though its absence from the website adds some uncertainty.

The eighth-pallet format complements the quarter-pallet line at low incremental cost, but reduced slack under the 2022 cost pressure and no recent visibility raise the risk of it being folded into the general range.
Structurally declining demand for media displays, falling short of aspirations as energy and board costs surge, prompts problemistic search and a shift of resources to stronger core formats.
